```python
def resultArray(nums: List[int]) -> List[int]:
    arr1 = []
    arr2 = []
    
    # First two elements
    arr1.append(nums[0])
    arr2.append(nums[1])
    
    # Process remaining elements
    for i in range(2, len(nums)):
        if arr1[-1] > arr2[-1]:
            arr1.append(nums[i])
        else:
            arr2.append(nums[i])
    
    return arr1 + arr2
```
